title: Kenyan Stew with Pinto Beans
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with Kenyan spices and pinto beans. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: Blend of spices, including cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Kenyan spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pinto beans, diced tomatoes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the roasted peanuts (if using).
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (optional).
